<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to,from,heading,body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY copy "©">
  <!ENTITY reg "®">
  <!ENTITY trade "™">
  <!NOTATION gif SYSTEM "image/gif">
  <!NOTATION jpeg SYSTEM "image/jpeg">
  <!ENTITY image SYSTEM "graphic.gif" NDATA gif>
]>
<note>
  <to>Tove</to>
  <from>Jani</from>
  <heading>Reminder</heading>
  <body>Don't forget me this weekend! © ® ™</body>
</note>

    <header>
        <title>XInclude and CData Test</title>
    </header>
    <body>
        <content>
            <![CDATA[
                Here is some unparsed text containing special characters like <, >, &, and quotes " '
                inside a CDATA section, followed by an XInclude element.
            ]]>
        </content>
        <xi:include href="included-file.xml" parse="xml">
            <xi:fallback>
                <error>Included document could not be loaded.</error>
            </xi:fallback>
        </xi:include>
    </body>
</root>
